governedCriteria.observation: Both focused unchecked CheckTag renders show a clear Scholarly Blue focus outline; Avalonia sampled 152 ring pixels, matched 140 to #2A599C within tolerance, and passed at ratio 0.9210526315789473.
The Avalonia render contains the blue PART_FocusRing and no black Fluent focus adorner; the governed pixel probe found zero unexpected dark ring pixels.
Both platforms render the label Check tag at the same checkpoint with checked=false, focused=true, checkbox role, and an accessible unchecked state.

The focus ring is overlaid rather than participating in layout; the adjacent editor keeps its position, and the same-candidate headless contract asserts identical CheckTag bounds before and after Tab focus.

observations: The focused CheckTag remains the single visible focus target in both production full-window captures.
Native font metrics and full-window viewport sizes differ, but component meaning, unchecked state, keyboard focus, label, and restrained focus treatment match.
No new decoration, token, content, or adjacent layout change is present.
limitations: The platforms use different native renderers and full-window viewport sizes, so this review does not claim pixel equality.
No CheckTag-specific numeric cross-platform geometry override exists; acceptance is limited to the governed qualitative focus-state criteria and the same-candidate bounds assertion.
